entries.not_relevant_because: Both manuscripts (The ℓ¹-Bass Conjecture for Discrete Groups, 5 October 2026; The Bass trace conjecture and the characteristic-zero Kaplansky idempotent conjecture, 24 September 2026) concern the Hattori–Stallings trace on K₀ of group algebras (ℓ¹(G), ℂG, ℤG) and its support on conjugacy classes. Their 'Bass conjecture' is Bass's trace conjecture (refs Bass1976, Bass1979 'Traces and Euler characteristics'), not the Wikipedia problem on finite generation of the higher algebraic K-groups Kᵢ(X) or K'ᵢ(X) of regular schemes of finite type over ℤ. Neither manuscript mentions finite generation of K-groups, regular schemes over ℤ, G-theory, or motivic/Chow groups; the family does not bear on this problem.
